summary: Converts a float argument to an integer via CRTFtol, then selects a double from one of two clamped 8-entry regions of a caller-provided float table: indices 59..66 for non-negative input, indices 51..58 (magnitude) for negative input.

local_names.v3: truncated index for the positive branch
local_names.v4: magnitude of the index for the negative branch

operations.description: Convert float a2 to integer v3 via CRTFtol.
Branch on sign of v3: if v3 >= 0 use the positive table side, otherwise negate to v4 and use the negative side.
Clamp positive-side index: if v3 >= 8, force v3 = 7.
Return double this[v3 + 59] from the positive-side table region.
Compute v4 = -v3 as the magnitude for the negative branch.
Clamp negative-side index: if v4 >= 8, force v4 = 7.
Return double this[v4 + 51] from the negative-side table region.
